mapper.select: SELECT * FROM inquiry_room WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'OPEN' LIMIT 1

SELECT r.*, u.name as userName, (SELECT message FROM inquiry_message WHERE room_id = r.id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) as lastMessage, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inquiry_message WHERE room_id = r.id AND is_read = 'N' AND sender_role = 'USER') as unreadCount FROM inquiry_room r JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE inquiry_room SET admin_id = #{adminId} WHERE id = #{roomId} AND admin_id IS NULL
UPDATE inquiry_room SET status = 'CLOSED' WHERE id = #{roomId}
UPDATE inquiry_message SET is_read = 'Y' WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND sender_role = 'USER' AND is_read = 'N'
